sloka: अनन्तरं स राजर्षिर्निमिरिक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः ।अत्रिमङ्गिरसं चैव भृगुं चैव तपोधनम् ।। ७.५५.९ ॥
transliteration: anantaraṁ sa rājarṣirnimirikṣvākunandanaḥ ।atrimaṅgirasaṁ caiva bhṛguṁ caiva tapodhanam ।। 7.55.9 ॥

translations.english: Subsequently, the royal sage Nimi, a descendant of Ikshvaku, approached Atri, Angiras, and Bhrigu, who were rich in penance.
